description: Department of Local Government - Declared Vice Chairman of Addalachenai Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the election and declaration of a Vice Chairman for a local authority (Addalachenai Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes and results at the local government level, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette (Type 7). While it names an individual (Seeni Muhamathu Muhamathu Haneefa), this is in the context of declaring an election result rather than a government personnel appointment, so government classification types (1-3) do not take precedence.
